confidence_basis: Main PDF, OpenDataLoader output, fallback text search, rendered methods/results pages, and publisher/source-route checks were reviewed. The static near/far auditory layout, 150 ms white-noise bursts, 70 dB equalization, 5 ms far-sound lead, electrical tactile target/nontarget structure, catch rows, 150-trial task composition, and cane/handle/training blocks are reported. Remaining gaps are ITI/jitter, numeric response window, exact tactile pulse duration/current, and detailed randomization.

profile_recreation_assessment.reason: The audio-tactile task can be recreated as a static near/far speaker PPS design with cane and handle/tool-use conditions. It is not a dynamic looming profile, and exact electrical pulse/current plus ITI/response timeout would need reasonable lab defaults.

source_checks.scope: PDF pages 2-4 for rationale, Procedure and Materials, Figure 1, auditory/tactile apparatus, trial counts, blocked conditions, and catch-trial sanity checks.
Used as primary extracted text map and checked against rendered PDF pages and targeted text searches.
Targeted searches for white noise, 150 ms, 70 dB, near/far, 125 cm, 5 ms, target/nontarget/catch, blocked, counterbalanced, XGen, DS7A, response, ITI, and timeout terms.
Visual layout check of methods, Figure 1, and results pages; temporary rendered page images were not committed.
Tracked ledger and publisher/source route did not provide a usable supplement; missing ITI and tactile pulse details remain main-PDF gaps.

review_attempts.result: Mapped automated candidate Segment 1-4 values and located methods pages for manual checking.
Confirmed static near/far white-noise bursts, two loudspeaker locations, 125 cm far distance, 150 ms duration, 70 dB ear-level equalization, and the 5 ms far-sound timing correction.
Confirmed weak target and strong nontarget electrical stimulation on the right index finger, simultaneous near sound/touch, and far sound onset 5 ms before touch.
Separated target, nontarget, and sound-only catch rows from blocked cane, handle, and sighted training conditions.
Confirmed 150 trials per described task with 30 trials in each target/nontarget near/far row plus 30 catch trials; no tactile-only baseline was found.
Rendered pages 2-4 were inspected to verify methods text, Figure 1 geometry, and catch/results statements.
No usable supplement was available in the tracked/publisher route; ITI, response deadline, and exact tactile pulse parameters remain unreported after review.

stimulus_type.value: Auditory stimuli were 150 ms bursts of white noise.
stimulus_type.evidence_note: The sound class and duration are stated in the methods text.

source_provenance.value: Sounds were generated by two identical loudspeakers; phono-spectral waves were recorded by computer to verify equal sounds at the origin.
source_provenance.evidence_note: The paper describes speaker generation and verification, but not the source file/noise seed.

trajectory_count.value: Two static auditory positions/conditions: near the stimulated hand and far on the floor near the cane tip.
trajectory_count.evidence_note: Near and far sound locations are the task's auditory spatial factor.

trajectory_path.value: Near sound was close to the stimulated right hand; far sound was on the floor about 125 cm from the hand, corresponding to average cane length and the fixed cane-tip location.
trajectory_path.evidence_note: The method and figure give the static spatial layout.

stimulus_speed.value: No looming or moving auditory stimulus was used; near and far sounds were static speaker locations.
stimulus_speed.evidence_note: The task uses static near/far locations rather than a moving trajectory.

auditory_conditions.value: Near versus far sound location was crossed with weak target, strong nontarget, and sound-only catch rows; tool state was manipulated in separate cane/handle/training blocks.
auditory_conditions.page_or_section: PDF pp.2-4, Procedure, Figure 1, and Results
auditory_conditions.evidence_note: Sound location and tool/training conditions are reported as design factors.

gain_envelope.value: Near and far sounds were equalized to 70 dB at the participant's ear; sounds were also checked for equality at origin.
gain_envelope.evidence_note: SPL equalization is reported; no detailed gain curve is needed for static bursts.

renderer_or_apparatus.value: Two identical loudspeakers placed near and far from the stimulated hand; XGen software controlled stimulus presentation and response recording.
renderer_or_apparatus.evidence_note: The apparatus and control software are described in the methods section.

trial_rows_families.value: Rows/families were weak tactile target plus near/far sound, strong tactile nontarget plus near/far sound, and sound-only catch trials.
trial_rows_families.evidence_note: The 150-trial composition lists the trial rows explicitly.

condition_intermixing.value: Near/far sound trials and target/nontarget/catch rows occurred within the task; cane, handle, and sighted training conditions were separate blocked conditions.
condition_intermixing.evidence_note: The paper separates within-task trial rows from blocked tool conditions.

blocked_or_random_order.value: Participants performed cane and handle tasks in two blocked conditions with counterbalanced order; sighted subjects had two additional cane-training blocks immediately after and 1 day after training.
blocked_or_random_order.evidence_note: Blocked condition structure and order counterbalancing are reported.

iti_jitter_policy.evidence_note: No ITI, jitter range, or inter-trial distribution was found in the main PDF or available source route.

response_window.evidence_note: Participants responded as rapidly as possible, but no numeric deadline or scoring window was found.

task_sequence_rules.value: Subjects verbally responded only to weak tactile targets, ignored sounds, received 30 familiarization trials before the experiment, and should not respond on strong nontarget or sound-only catch trials.
task_sequence_rules.evidence_note: Response rules and familiarization are reported.

tactile_stimulus.value: Two DS7A Digitimer constant-current stimulators delivered weak target and strong nontarget electrical stimuli through Neuroline electrodes on the upper side of the right index finger; intensities were calibrated to about 90% and 100% perception.
tactile_stimulus.evidence_note: Device, site, target/nontarget role, and perceptual calibration are reported; pulse duration/current are not.

soa_table.value: Near sound and tactile stimuli were simultaneous; far sound onset preceded tactile onset by 5 ms to compensate for the extra sound-travel distance.
soa_table.evidence_note: The SOA/timing correction is explicitly reported.

baseline_strategy.value: No separate tactile-only baseline is reported; the task estimates PPS effects from near-versus-far sound comparisons across handle/cane/training conditions.
baseline_strategy.evidence_note: Baseline is a within-design comparison rather than a distinct tactile-only trial family.

baseline_timing.value: No tactile-only baseline SOA schedule was used or reported.
baseline_timing.evidence_note: The study uses near/far and tool-condition comparisons instead of a baseline timing ladder.

catch_trial_type.value: Catch trials were sound-only no-response trials; results report responses on fewer than 1% of catch trials.
catch_trial_type.page_or_section: PDF pp.2 and 4, Procedure and Results
catch_trial_type.evidence_note: Catch type and a false-response sanity check are reported.

repetitions_per_tactile_soa_condition.value: Per described task: 30 weak-target trials with near sound, 30 weak-target trials with far sound, 30 strong-nontarget trials with near sound, and 30 strong-nontarget trials with far sound.
repetitions_per_tactile_soa_condition.evidence_note: The trial counts are explicitly listed in the task-composition paragraph.

baseline_count.value: No separate tactile-only baseline trials are reported.
baseline_count.evidence_note: There is no baseline row to count.

catch_count.value: Per described task: 30 sound-only catch trials.
catch_count.evidence_note: The catch count is explicitly listed.

block_count.value: All participants completed cane and handle blocked conditions; sighted participants also completed cane blocks immediately after 10 min training and 1 day after training.
block_count.evidence_note: Blocked condition count differs by group because sighted subjects had extra training phases.

total_trial_count.value: The described task contains 150 trials per administered condition; this implies 300 trials for blind participants across cane/handle and 600 for sighted participants if each listed sighted condition used the same task.
total_trial_count.evidence_note: Per-task total is reported; group totals are derived because the paper does not explicitly multiply across conditions.

critical_caveats: This is a static near/far auditory task, not a looming or receding trajectory profile.
The exact white-noise source file, random seed, and spectral recipe are not supplied.
The exact electrical tactile pulse duration, current, and waveform are not reported.
ITI or jitter policy is not reported.
No numeric response deadline/window is reported for the voice-key response.
Detailed trial randomization within the 150-trial task is not reported.
The paper strongly implies the 150-trial task repeats in each blocked condition, but group totals are derived rather than directly stated.
next_manual_action: Use this as a high-confidence static near/far tool-condition template candidate. Exact toolkit recreation should label missing tactile pulse parameters, ITI, response window, and randomization details as lab-default approximations unless a supplement or protocol source becomes available.
